Messages.Author: Philippe Steels
Messages.Body:
If you play a clan impersonation on Masika to make him a Malkhavian, then if
you play a Madness Network, Masika could perform X actions by turn (X is the
number of Meth. in game...)
Is it a possible combo?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


It works, yes. Masika untaps between turns, then takes an action at the
end of the current (active) player's Minion Phase.

Assuming no one feels inspired to burn the Madness Network, of course.

Messages.Author: Alexander Phoon
Messages.Body:
This combo was pulled at a tournament here in NZ last year. Worked very well.

The guy came first (as he deserved for such a kewl inovative deck).

He found a few problems with vote decks though (need many eagles sight) and the
advantages diminish as more Methusaleh's get ousted. Still it was pretty messy
being bled 5 times in one turn by Masika!

The silly combo using Clan Impersonation are the Giovanni (nec) and Renegade Garou
or Black Spiral Buddies / Muddle Vampire Hunters. Its pretty ugly when they throw
a couple of Garou at you to die then bring em back! And with Charlotte Giovanni in
the game ......(shudder!)

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
Speaking of Madness Networks and Clan Impersonation...this is a bit strange and
perhaps even useless combo (since it requires so many cards), but what if you
Clan Impersonated Carlotta Giovanni. Then you play out your turn and have
someone play Reversal of Fortunes. Have Carlotta retrieve it and during the
next turn you play it again and you go back and forth between just you and
either your predator or prey. Of course you'd need enough votes to pass and
you'd begin to run out of cards but I'm sure you'd annoy the heck out of the
other players (in a 4-5 player game for instance) if you and the other guy
played 10 or so turns in a row!

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: davey sprocket
Messages.Body:
Even better, you could use Madness Network/Dramatic Upheaval. Let your
prey take her turn, then for your first Networked action, pass Dramatic
Upheaval with any Malk, and switch places with your prey. Bleed a bit
with your other Malks, then let your former prey's (now your predator's)
turn end. Oh, look, it's your turn now! Use Carlotta to get back the
Upheaval, end your turn, and repeat. You get an extra turn for each other
player, and no one else can take a turn as your predator. Of course, it
only works until you get down to only two methuselahs, so be sure to save
the puny methuselah for last.
If, instead of using Carlotta, you just have a TON of Dramatic
Upheavals, you can pass one on your turn to swap with your predator, and
one on her turn, the next turn to become that methuselah's prey, thereby
preventing every player but you and a chosen prey from taking turns. It's
especially nice to deny turns to players who might try to stop the
madness. If necessary, you can also change preys to someone weaker (by
switching with their predator.)
And If you have a Prince, you can use the even more powerful
Kindred Restructure. This can not only give you the weakest prey, but
give her the strongest one, to ensure she doesn't do anything useful like
oust another methuselah. Also, you can deny turns with one vote instead
of two.
Things start to get interesting when you add in Life Boon. Life
Boon the first person to get ousted, then reset the table so you and she
are taking turns as predator of the weakest methuselah, denying everyone
else turns. This way, even if you don't oust someone, you can still get
the VP.

Enjoy!

-davey!
